label: A partial fan-out exits 2 from fanout-run.cjs and the spawn step has no partial path, so the parent never reaches phase_synthesis and the successful lineages are never merged into a report.

buildPoolSummary returns per-lineage results, but writeOrchestrationSummary serializes only the aggregate summary, so the committed summary has counts and no labels even though the process holds the labels.
